question: An object is placed in front of a convex mirror at a point between infinity and the pole of the mirror. The image formed is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**virtual and erect**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An object placed between infinity and the pole of a convex mirror always forms a **virtual and erect** image.
 
• Convex mirrors diverge light rays, making them appear to come from a point behind the mirror.
